assessment_scope: Exact ten changed models, unchanged Records/Installation, complete source disposition/inventory and named supporting interactions; full Design package approval for Delivery planning, not source deletion or implementation completion.
independence_basis: Independent nonauthor reviewer assessed revised whole owner package, source disposition and recovery inventory, affected specialist contracts and unchanged record/installation/example interactions. All three reported preservation findings were reassessed against author corrections; reviewer made no engineering edits.
limitations: Approval authorizes planning reliance on this exact package only. No tests/fixtures are deleted, no implementation protection-equivalence claim is made and no public compatibility/publication action is executed.

Delivery must enumerate concrete transitive consumers and actual test populations with case-group exceptions, prove retained failure detection and reconcile all additions/removals before final closeout. A newly discovered unmapped current behavioral obligation returns to Design; it cannot silently become deferred or be retired by this approval.
Existing unchanged examples are inspected for declared interaction semantics; these synthetic records and structural author checks are not executed assessment or runtime-success evidence.
rationale: Behavior and realization: pass. Existing Skill/CLI/Engineering owners cover all selected source families; whole source inventory includes116 exact baseline identities, companion test documents and machine resources. Reviewer independently recovered all116 baseline hashes and found no unmapped source/companion membership. Distinct current acceptance intent remains an input to Delivery, not blanket executable deletion.

Specialist preservation: pass after correction. Skill retains exact public operations, closed result/authority domains and output groups; CI bounded repair retains strict admission/action/evidence limits. Workflow owns follow-up statuses and fields; Assessment owns Verify outcome/mode/evidence domains and RC-SR-23 relaxed suffix semantics. Historical metrics/ledger enums are explicitly separate from current public/parser outcomes.

Compatibility and ownership: pass. Repository all-specs retirement does not ban portable customer feature formats or revive retired lifecycle engines. Generic observed CLI, primary recording, advanced store and discovery domains stay separate. Records safety, Installation conflict/force and external release/PR authority remain independently owned.

Resource and boundary realization: pass. Byte-preserving shared methods move to maintained templates/shared inputs with closed scripts manifest and exact existing projection consumers; raw method bytes and skill-relative resource identities survive. Historical activation/grandfathering/rollback readers retire while explicit feature grammar, model/unsafe-path/unknown-value proof and package integrity remain.

Complete test maintenance and routing: pass. Actual discovered, parameterized, inline/helper and outside-fixture cases require retain/refine/remove disposition; unknown protection blocks completion. Actual local/range deletion and both rename sides must route current owner/consumer checks; unknown and mixed paths block without synthetic success. No permanent per-file retirement registry or measurement programme is added.

Composition/architecture/acceptance: pass. Existing parent graphs own unchanged product composition; added diagnostic runtime/deployment views define local log boundary. Current examples retain recordable-claim versus justified-readiness and independent-correction semantics. New source/consumer, package-without-specs, malformed-current-input and handoff-suffix scenarios supply concrete outcomes for Delivery.

Decisions/recovery/adoption: pass. Important retained scope has receiving owners and explicit retirement for historical rollout/format/metric obligations; original identities/judgments are preserved. Earlier no-whole-directory and17-skill pilot scope is qualified by current complete retirement. Coherent source/reader recovery and reviewed implementation plus distinct Verify remain adoption conditions. All three first-pass findings resolved.
summary: Reconciled Design preserves important current contracts and explicitly retires obsolete sources and validation obligations across the complete selected scope.
